change.title: Make the Artemis Budget Hard-Disk Office a fixed package
change.reason: Remove Abacus from both versions because it is independently supplied. Apply the same fixed-package rule to the separately selectable network card. change.title: Consolidate product composition roles and simplify Regular Support inclusions
change.reason: Retire the composition-line role field. Preserve each existing element_type classification and append any role text to it; where only role was populated, use that text as element_type. Empty role fields are removed without inventing classifications. Apply this only to composition lines, not participant, reference or technical-definition roles.
